name: Akasaka Hirofumi
source:
Hirofumi is Takaaki's senpai (upperclassman). He seems to want to take Takaaki under his wing and make him more like himself, the cool senior that he is. Hirofumi is one of those kids from the other neighborhood that presents a cool and tough image. He enjoys riding his motorcycle.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/xasy/xasy.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
